settings.language_hint: The Oracle responds in your chosen language. Switch any time.

settings.theme_dark_hint: Forest deep with amber accents. Solray's resting state.
settings.theme_light_hint: Pearl background, deep-forest ink. Best in daylight.
settings.analytics_on_hint: On. Solray records anonymous usage events (which pages, which features) so we can fix what's broken and improve what's working. We never record chat content, birth data, or anything that identifies you beyond your account.
settings.analytics_off_hint: Off. We won't record any usage events from this device.

settings.collective_off_hint: Off. Your chart is excluded from the Collective. Existing signal data is removed. The Oracle reads only your chart and your sessions, not the wider field.
settings.birth_details_hint: Changing these recalculates your full chart. Useful if your time of birth was wrong, or you've learned new information from family.
settings.subscription_hint: Manage billing, see renewal date, cancel.
settings.birth_city_select_hint: Pick a city from the suggestions so we can geolocate it precisely.
